entities.summary: The Chekhov Shop is a museum in Taganrog, Russia. This is a two-storey house where the Russian writer Anton Chekhov stayed with his family from 1869 to 1874. November 3, 1977 museum "The Chekhov Shop" was open offering visitors objects and documents related to Chekhov youth years and life of the Chekhov family.
